description: This file defines a React functional component called PreviewCanvas that provides a container for displaying a live preview of other components. It handles props for customizing height, component rendering via IDs, override properties, notes, children content, and header actions. The component dynamically loads preview components based on IDs using utility functions and manages default rendering when children are not provided.
